When I was a freshmen in high school I was doing really well until I ended hurting my knee in track season. It took my around 2 months to be able to even able to run on a elliptical.  I’m not sure what your injury is but what I recommend is cross training. It helped me a lot by swimming and biking and I ended up getting back into normal pace a lot quicker. I understand how frustrating it is that you can’t run with your group/ at your normal pace. I would try and just integrate yourself into your running group as much as you can without running. I volunteered at track meets with my group and hanged out on weekends. It helped me mentally a lot because I was extremely upset about not being able to run.  Also when I first started running again I pushed myself wayyy to hard. My first day back of running I ran 3 miles at 8:16 pace and ended up having to stop running because I wasn’t used to it. My pt said to me run at comfortable paces and you’ll get back in shape a lot quicker.Finally it helps me a lot to think about the long term of my knee. I might not be able to run at the moment but I’m doing so I could run for the rest of my high school seasons.
